title: [review] tx_queue.py:496: complete(success=True) signals
description: Lines 496-497 signal the reservation as True BEFORE checking if the entry is at queue head (line 500). If a higher-priority entry was inserted after reserve() but before complete(), self._entries[0] is entry will be False, the entry stays in queue (only a warning is logged), but the reservation was already signaled True. The entry can be reserved and transmitted again, causing duplicate transmission while the original caller believes it succeeded.
close_reason: Fixed: Moved reservation.set_result(True) inside the block where entry is confirmed at head. The reservation is now only signaled True AFTER removing the entry, preventing duplicate transmissions when higher-priority entries preempt. Added regression test.
